host_tests.chromium_scope: Actual HTML/JS over local HTTP to persistent actual sketch C++ with mocked hardware; 200/300/400ms RTT, jitter, touch, release during ARM, lost STOP/HOLD/session response, stale requests and recovery while still physically holding the browser pointer. Does not measure WiFiS3/phone latency.

behavior.deadline_anchor: receipt of each valid one-use HOLD; expired phase cannot resume
behavior.bound_scope: From the browser processing release or physical communication loss to output OFF, assuming functioning timer interrupts; one already-issued HOLD may renew once. Excludes browser event-delivery delay and physical braking; not an independent CPU watchdog.
behavior.recovery: New actual press after release, idempotent session renewal after failure, no automatic rearm; no manual reload required after ordinary transport error
behavior.stop_type: EN zero, both direction inputs LOW; free coast

live_serial.scope: Live post-upload boot identity and OFF diagnostics. No physical voltage/current measurement or motor request.

physical_acceptance: User-reported passed on 2026-09-19 after returning and refreshing the page: continuous hold, release and new press; repeatedly reported Jo, funguje to, perfektni. No agent-initiated motor request.

previous_hold_version.status: Inactive historical version; known latency sensitivity reproduced, user reports interruptions even during actual holding.

rollback_history.final_user_request: Fix hold-to-run and upload autonomously during meeting; also create a new geared printable car.

limitations: Actual phone/Arduino WiFi roundtrip unmeasured; first challenge older than500ms still fails closed.

User was away during bounded no-HTTP monitoring; those windows do not prove failure during a press.
Missing decoupling capacitors and unknown motor current/actual current battery population remain separate hardware issues; newly owned supplies do not prove installation.
DigitalRead OFF is software/MCU evidence, not complete wiring verification or physical current measurement.
